title: Face a practice target and circle it
setup: On an upright player with a camera and configured controls, choose **Lock-On** and assign the practice target. Press **L** to face it and circle, then press **L** again to return to moving relative to the view. [Set up the practice target](/player-controls#face-a-practice-target)

title: Watch movement corrections on a LAN guest
setup: Put the label under the persistent game owner and move around as a predicting LAN guest. It shows outstanding inputs and the most recent correction in metres. [Synchronize player movement](/networked-movement)
